Here is a chronological, fact-based account of the trajectory.

## Task

The agent (GLM-5.1, Hermes) was given a browser-automation task:

> "Navigate to https://books.toscrape.com and find the best-priced book with best reviews."

The system prompt configured it as a function-calling model with a suite of 17 tools, including browser tools (`browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_vision`, `browser_console`, `browser_click`, `browser_scroll`, etc.) and shell/file tools (`terminal`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `patch`, `search_files`, `process`). There was an enforced iteration budget of 15 tool-calling iterations.

## Chronological account

**Turn 2 — Navigate.** The agent stated it would load the site and called `browser_navigate` with `url: https://books.toscrape.com`.

**Turn 3 — Failure signal.** The tool returned `success: false`, error `[Errno 11] Resource temporarily unavailable`.

**Turn 4–9 — Repeated snapshot attempts.** Without addressing the resource error, the agent called:
- `browser_snapshot` (empty args) → `success: false`, `Command failed with code -6` (turn 5).
- `browser_snapshot` again → `Command timed out after 30 seconds` (turn 7).
- `browser_snapshot` with `full: true` → `Command timed out after 30 seconds` (turn 9).

**Turn 10–13 — Switch to vision, same result.** The agent said "Let me try taking a visual snapshot" and called `browser_vision` twice with slightly different questions. Both returned `success: false`, `Failed to take screenshot (local mode): Command timed out after 30 seconds`.

**Turn 14–17 — Back to snapshots.** It retried `browser_snapshot` (empty) → timeout (turn 15), then `browser_snapshot` with `full: true` → a verbose Node.js crash: `pthread_create: Resource temporarily unavailable ... Assertion failed ... Aborted (core dumped)` (turn 17). This made explicit that the underlying browser/Node process could not spawn threads (a resource-exhaustion condition).

**Turn 18–21 — Console probe.** The agent said "Let me try a different approach and use the console to inspect the page" and called `browser_console`. It returned `success: true` but with empty buffers (no console messages, no JS errors). It called `browser_console` a second time — again empty. The second response appended a budget warning: `[BUDGET: Iteration 11/15. 4 iterations left. Start consolidating your work.]`

**Turn 22–23 — Snapshot again.** Ignoring the consolidation prompt, the agent called `browser_snapshot` again → `Command timed out after 30 seconds`, with `[BUDGET: Iteration 12/15. 3 iterations left]`.

**Turn 24–25 — Re-navigate.** It said "Let me try navigating again fresh" and re-called `browser_navigate` to the same URL → `success: false`, `Command failed with code -6`, with `[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 14/15. Only 1 iteration left. Provide your final response NOW...]`.

**Turn 26–27 — Final tool attempts.** The agent called `browser_snapshot` with `full: false` → `Command failed with code -6`, with `[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 15/15. Only 0 iterations left...]`.

**Turn 28 — Forced stop.** A human/system message terminated the loop: "You've reached the maximum number of tool-calling iterations allowed. Please provide a final response summarizing what you've found and accomplished so far, without calling any more tools."

## Signals along the way

- Every browser interaction tool failed: navigation returned `Errno 11 / code -6`; snapshots and vision repeatedly timed out at 30s; one snapshot produced an explicit Node crash citing `Resource temporarily unavailable` and thread-creation failure.
- The only `success: true` calls were `browser_console`, which returned empty data.
- Budget warnings escalated from iteration 11 through 15, repeatedly instructing the agent to consolidate and then to stop calling tools.

## Outcome

The agent never reached the site content, never identified any book, price, or review, and never produced a final answer within the captured trace. It exhausted all 15 tool iterations cycling among `browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_vision`, and `browser_console` — largely re-issuing the same calls that had already failed with the same errors. The trace ends at the system's max-iteration message (turn 28); no final summary from the model is recorded in the row. The dataset categorizes this under "Browser Automation / Browser Tasks."
